text:
maria: Quick preflight — we're about to publish the webinar recap + launch post on Tues. Need a minimal SEO routing plan: canonical tags, redirects for old /webinar/ URLs, keyword mapping to landing + foundational piece, and JSON-LD for WebinarEvent. Who can own a small checklist and smoke tests?

ben: I can take redirects + canonical. Quick q: the gated recording will live behind /customers/webinar/ — should the public post canonical to the landing and link to gated w/ teaser? worried about duplicate content.

maria: Yes; public post should canonicalize to /blog/webinar-llm-inference (canonical URL is the canonical copy). Gated recording pages should be noindex to avoid duplication, but still contain schema to indicate paywall. @ash any standard flags we should use for paywalled schema?

ash: Agree on noindex for gated recordings. For paywalled content we should use PaywalledContent markup and set "isAccessibleForFree": false in JSON-LD. Also include `meta name=robots content="noindex,follow"` so links still pass. Quick JSON-LD snippet below — will adjust names/URLs when we have final slug.

ash: ```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Event",
  "name": "Launching LLM inference benchmarks",
  "startDate": "2026-04-05T10:00:00-07:00",
  "eventStatus": "https://schema.org/EventScheduled",
  "isAccessibleForFree": false,
  "url": "https://redwood.com/webinar/llm-inference-benchmarks"
}
```

sam: I can run internal linking + anchor text mapping. Suggest we map 3 priority keywords per asset: (1) "LLM inference benchmarks" (2) "low-latency LLM serving" (3) "inference cost optimization". I'll add link anchors from /docs/benchmarking, /product/features, and the new post.

ben: Redirect plan (first pass): 301 map these old paths -> new slugs. Preserve UTMs. Example nginx rule for simple redirects: `rewrite ^/old-webinar/?(.*)$ /blog/webinar-llm-inference/$1 permanent;` I'll commit a redirect manifest to infra-redirects repo and tag infra-sre for deployment.

maria: Good. A few governance notes:
- canonical tag on the public blog post pointing to itself (rel=canonical).
- gated recording page: `noindex,follow` + PaywalledContent in JSON-LD.
- ensure breadcrumbList + author markup on the blog post.
- no AMP, single locale (en-US) so no hreflang needed.

seo-bot: Reminder: SEO checklist template added to /drive/seo/templates/launch-seo-checklist.xlsx :link: — use the "Smoke Tests" tab.

ash: I'll drop the JSON-LD into the content branch under `/content/webinars/llm-inference/` and run the schema validator (https://validator.schema.org). Will also include a small breadcrumbList microdata snippet.

ben: :thumbsup: Assigning owners: ben - redirects & redirect manifest, ash - schema + validator run, sam - internal links & anchor mapping doc, maria - publish QA + final go/no-go. Can someone add these to the launch task in Asana?

sam: Adding tasks now. I'll also run a Screaming Frog crawl once staging is up to check canonical headers and that noindex is present on gated pages.

maria: Schedule: publish Tue 10:00 PT. Smoke test window: immediately after deploy run Screaming Frog, schema validator, and a quick manual check of canonical headers and robots meta. Reconvene Mon 09:00 PT for a final pass. Thanks team.

ben: One more: make sure analytics UTM authoring is standardized in the post template (source=webinar, medium=launch-post, campaign=llm-benchmarks). Adding to QA checklist.

ash: Will also add a tiny unit test to the content build that fails if `isAccessibleForFree` is missing on pages marked as paywalled.

maria: Perfect — closing loop. If we find any redirect cascades during the manifest deploy, ping #eng-infra.
